data.gender_notes: Manuj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Manuj is derived from the Sanskrit language. It is a combination of two words, Man and Uj. Man means human, and Uj means born. Therefore, the name Manuj can be translated to mean 'human born'. The name Manuj carries the meaning “Man: Human. Uj: Born.” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Manuj usually hope their child will grow to embody man: human. uj: born. and live with faith, good character and purpose.

vedic_reference.note: Manu is the lawgiver in Hindu Mythology. He is the author of the 'Manusmriti', the ancient Hindu legal text.

historical_references.reference: Manu Smriti, an ancient Indian legal text, is attributed to Manu, a legendary lawgiver and sage in Hindu tradition. It is believed that Manu Smriti was composed around 200 BCE.
historical_references.context: Manu was the author of the Manu Smriti, a foundational text of Hindu law.

historical_references.reference: Manavadhipurana, an important Purana in Hinduism, is also known as the Manu Purana. It describes Manu as the first human being on Earth, who was created by the gods after the deluge (Pralaya).
historical_references.context: Manu is considered the first human being in Hinduism.
